bibl.title: A Ptolemaic-Roman Temple Foundation at Tell Timai.
bibl.seg: James E. Bennett, A Ptolemaic-Roman Temple Foundation at Tell Timai.
bibl.note: Mission of the University of Hawai'i, 2009-2017. - Tell Timai [Thmouis] in context. - Location of the temple foundations. - Previous excavations of the foundations. - The construction techniques. - Associated monuments and architecture. - Dating the construction of the temple. - Date range of the foundation platform. - The foundations after the late Ptolemaic-early Roman Period. - Preliminary conclusions.
